skill.name: ai-avatar-video
skill.description: Create AI avatar, talking-head, and lip-sync videos with the RunComfy CLI. Routes requests across OmniHuman, Wan, HappyHorse, and Seedance models.
skill.summary: Routes avatar and lip-sync video requests to the right RunComfy model and CLI inputs.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Static analysis overreported Markdown backticks and documentation links as command execution and network issues; those entries are false positives. The real risks are RunComfy credential persistence in a hidden config file, package-manager execution guidance, and privacy-sensitive avatar media sent to a third-party model API. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Credential persistence in a hidden config file
remediation.suggestion: Document token removal, permission checks, and the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN alternative. Ask before running login on shared machines or containers.
Move npm and npx installation steps outside automatic agent workflows. Require explicit user confirmation before installing or running CLI packages.

remediation.issue: Sensitive likeness and voice media processing
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear consent and third-party processing notice before generation. Refuse requests that impersonate real people without permission.

content.user_title: Create AI Avatar Videos with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Avatar video requests often need different models for portraits, scripts, or audio files. This skill selects a RunComfy route and prepares the right CLI inputs.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests by audio file, written script, portrait style, and cinematic needs.
Routes portrait and voice inputs to OmniHuman for audio-driven avatar clips.
Uses Wan models for lip-sync scenes or stylized character animation.
Uses HappyHorse when the user has a script but no audio file.
Uses Seedance v2 Pro for cinematic shots with reference media.
Provides RunComfy CLI invocation patterns and model selection tips.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account, CLI access, and a valid token.
Needs hosted image and audio URLs for most audio-driven routes.
Quality depends on portrait framing, audio clarity, and model behavior.
Does not verify consent for likeness or voice assets automatically.

use_cases.title: Launch UGC Product Clips
use_cases.description: Create short talking-head videos from a product script, portrait, and voiceover.

use_cases.title: Dub Presenter Videos
use_cases.description: Reuse one approved portrait with different voice tracks for language-specific clips.

use_cases.title: Animate Brand Characters
use_cases.description: Turn a mascot image and voice file into a stylized speaking character.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Avatar Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a vertical avatar video from this portrait and voiceover. Use OmniHuman if it fits: [portrait URL], [audio URL].

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Best Route
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a talking-head video, but I only have a written script. Choose the right RunComfy model and prepare the inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multilingual Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan three avatar clips with the same approved portrait and separate audio tracks for English, Spanish, and French.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Cinematic Monologue
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cinematic Seedance v2 Pro prompt using this subject reference, scene reference, and voice track: [links].

output_examples.input: A founder portrait and a 15-second product voiceover.
output: Recommended route: OmniHuman for a portrait plus audio file.
Output plan: vertical clip, clean audio, head-and-shoulders framing, and saved video files.

output_examples.input: A script with no recorded audio for a social video.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: HappyHorse text-to-video. It will generate speech from the quoted script and create a short avatar clip.

output_examples.input: A mascot image and a character voice file.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: Wan 2-2 Animate. It is better for stylized characters than photoreal portrait routes.

best_practices: Use only portraits and voices with clear consent from the subject and speaker.
Host input assets on stable URLs before running the generation.
Keep spoken scripts short, then combine clips for longer videos.
anti_patterns: Do not create videos of real people without consent.
Do not use noisy music mixes when precise lip-sync is required.
Do not ask HappyHorse for exact sync to a specific external audio file.

faq.question: Does this skill create video locally?
faq.answer: No. It prepares RunComfy CLI calls that use RunComfy model APIs.

faq.question: Which model is the default?
faq.answer: OmniHuman is the default for one portrait and one audio file.

faq.question: Can I use only a script?
faq.answer: Yes. Use HappyHorse when no audio file is available.

faq.question: Can it animate illustrated characters?
faq.answer: Yes. Wan 2-2 Animate is recommended for stylized or mascot characters.

faq.question: What assets do I need?
faq.answer: Most routes need an image URL and an audio URL. HappyHorse can start from text.

faq.question: How should I handle consent?
faq.answer: Use only likeness and voice assets you are allowed to process and publish.
